question: How many players on each side are allowed on the field at a time in the game of Volleyball?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**6**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The correct answer to the question is option 1, which is 6 players on each side are allowed on the field at a time in the game of Volleyball.**
 
• **Volleyball is a team sport in which two teams of six players are separated by a net.** 
 
• Each team tries to score points by grounding a ball on the other team's court under organized rules. 
 
• Hence, the statement "How many players on each side are allowed on the field at a time in the game of Volleyball?" is correct, and the correct answer is option 1, which is 6 players on each side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, which is 8 players, is not correct as Volleyball is played with only six players on each side.
 
• Option 3, which is 7 players, is also not correct as Volleyball is played with only six players on each side.
 
• Option 4, which is 5 players, is not correct as Volleyball is played with six players on each side.
